ai_summary: Here's an executive summary of the provided financial document:  Axis Bank reported robust Q2FY27 performance with Net Profit surging 38% YOY to ₹7,003 crores, driven by strong 12% Net Interest Income (NII) growth and significantly improved asset quality, with GNPA decreasing to 1.16%. This was supported by healthy 21% YOY deposit growth and 23% YOY advances growth, while maintaining strong capital adequacy. However, a key concern is the decline in the low-cost CASA ratio from 40% to 36% YOY, and an 83% fall in trading income which suppressed overall other income growth.
